Deterministic homes for every directory under `D:\claude\`. Agents MUST place
new directories in the correct home — the `workspace_guard.py` check rejects

## Layout

```
D:\claude\
  stupidly-simple-cortex\           # Cortex brain (canonical, this repo)
  scc-v2\                           # kernel main worktree
